enunciado: With a=17 and b=5 show a+b, a-b, a*b, a/b (integer division), a%b (remainder) and the real division 17.0/5.0, one per line.
objetivos: Tell integer division from real division
pistas: Between two ints, / drops the decimals.
% gives the remainder of integer division.
If one operand is a float, the result is a float.
